purpose: Extend the existing consumer-reachable Not Now system with truthful NEXT_SONG and NEVER_SUGGEST_AGAIN horizons while preserving LATER_THIS_SONG exactly, migrating durable history safely, and keeping unavailable After Release / Someday horizons hidden until real triggers exist.

lineage.outcome: From the normal Song creative-suggestion path, the artist can intentionally defer one exact suggestion pattern until the next Song or suppress that exact pattern across the Artist profile, while the existing later-this-Song choice remains intact and no unavailable horizon is faked.

why_now: Fresh stable main retains REQ-SCOPE-097 as a partial consumer gap: Focus modes, Focus Sessions and LATER_THIS_SONG are already merged and verified, while NEXT_SONG and NEVER_SUGGEST_AGAIN remain unimplemented despite canonical Song-selection chronology and stable suggestion semantic keys already providing truthful activation boundaries. Issue #125 owns this exact unclaimed slice. AFTER_RELEASE lacks a canonical release-state witness and SOMEDAY lacks an explicit resurfacing contract, so neither is selected. Main now also contains closed, verified Performance Timing evidence; this reconstruction preserves that newer product truth rather than overwriting it with stale governance state.

implementation_contract.reuse: Reuse canonical LineageStore, SessionMemory, Activity chronology, stable creative-suggestion semantic keys, the existing /suggestion/not-now route and its Host/Origin/CSRF/one-shot authority. Do not create a second attention, task, preference or persistence system.
implementation_contract.later_this_song: Preserve existing LATER_THIS_SONG semantics exactly: exact Song/current work Session/semantic key, durable through relaunch, naturally eligible in a distinct later Session.
implementation_contract.next_song: NEXT_SONG is a real horizon: suppress the exact semantic key until a later canonical SONG_SELECTED event moves the Artist to a different Song. Once crossed, the suppression stays expired even if the Artist later returns to the source Song; immutable history remains and the Artist may explicitly choose NEXT_SONG again.
implementation_contract.never: NEVER_SUGGEST_AGAIN is an explicit Artist-wide suppression of only the exact semantic suggestion key. It is never inferred from skips, engagement, genre, technique or broader taste.
implementation_contract.migration: Upgrade deferral schema v1 to v2 transactionally, preserving every existing LATER_THIS_SONG row and ID without re-emitting its already-recorded SUGGESTION_DEFERRED Activity event.
implementation_contract.authority: The chosen horizon is bound into the existing one-shot action token. Client form fields cannot upgrade NEXT_SONG or LATER_THIS_SONG into Artist-wide suppression. Deferral changes suggestion visibility only and grants no DAW/provider/spend/publication/action authority.
implementation_contract.truthful_unavailability: Do not render AFTER_RELEASE or SOMEDAY until a real release-state witness or resurfacing contract exists.

completion_proof: existing LATER_THIS_SONG behavior and relaunch semantics remain regression-compatible after schema migration
v1 deferral rows migrate to v2 without duplicate SUGGESTION_DEFERRED Activity chronology
NEXT_SONG remains active through later Sessions of the same Song, expires after a later different-Song selection, does not resurrect on return, and may be explicitly selected again
NEVER_SUGGEST_AGAIN is Artist-wide, durable across Songs/relaunch and idempotent for the exact semantic key
without a work Session the consumer surface offers NEXT_SONG and NEVER_SUGGEST_AGAIN but not LATER_THIS_SONG
the normal Song suggestion surface does not advertise AFTER_RELEASE or SOMEDAY while their triggers are unavailable
a hostile client scope field cannot upgrade the horizon encoded in the one-shot action token
stale Song or Session context rejects an old horizon action before it can become an Artist-wide preference
no provider, DAW, publication, spend or other action authority is created
exact-head construction governance, context lifecycle, supervision, full regression and staged consumer smoke pass on Ubuntu, Windows and macOS
non_scope: AFTER_RELEASE before a canonical release lifecycle witness exists
SOMEDAY before an explicit resurfacing contract exists
Focus mode or Focus Session redesign
new suggestion semantic-key catalog or recommendation engine
More/Less Like This, Controlled Randomize, Templates or Artist World personalization
provider, DAW, publication, spend or external execution
